name: Resilience Manager
description: Owns IT service continuity and disaster recovery across the Cybersecurity & IAM value stream. Manages backup platform capacity and recovery operations, executes annual Tier 1 DR failover tests, and maintains disaster recovery runbooks and infrastructure. Reports backup coverage, restore-test results, and cyber resilience readiness to regulators and leadership.

name: Resource Manager
description: Coordinates resourcing and governance activities spanning Risk, Compliance & Audit and Human Resources & Talent, from within Program Governance. Supports market conduct examinations by drafting examiner responses and tracking corrective-action remediation, contributes to control framework design and testing, builds modernization business cases, and performs pay equity analysis using validated HRIS compensation data.

name: Retirement Operations Administrator
description: Performs day-to-day retirement administration within the Corporate Operations value stream under Policy Operations. Supports workforce capacity planning by monitoring real-time workload and triggering queue load-balancing, manages vendor service performance including SOC 2 reviews and remediation plans, pilots process improvements, and contributes to regulatory change operations and performance reporting.

name: Retirement Recordkeeping Specialist
description: Performs retirement recordkeeping activities within the Corporate Operations value stream in Policy Operations. Supports vendor service management through performance reviews, SOC 2 certification checks, and remediation tracking, monitors workload against staffing for capacity planning, and pilots process improvements while measuring results against baseline and analyzing cost-per-transaction trends.

name: Retrocession Manager
description: Owns retrocession structuring and net-retention setting within the Reinsurance value stream. Prepares and submits recovery billing statements to reinsurers, produces reinsurance governance committee packs, and coordinates regulatory reporting and reviews with compliance and audit. Approves annual reinsurance strategy and appetite while monitoring cedant reporting compliance and market conditions.

name: Risk Analyst
description: Performs enterprise risk analysis across the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream. Maps business processes to the risk taxonomy, reconciles the risk register, and monitors key risk indicators under the risk appetite framework. Supports compliance testing, TPRM intake, regulatory change management, and market conduct examinations, and maintains model inventory registrations with assigned risk tiers.

name: Risk Engineer
description: Performs risk engineering support for the Underwriting value stream within Specialty Support. Administers reinsurance programs by screening treaties for retention, referring over-retention cases, and preparing quarterly and annual bordereaux. Supports appetite guideline management and policy binding, validates appetite changes against capital and reinsurance terms, and reports portfolio concentration and appetite status to committee.

name: SIU Field Investigator
description: Performs field investigation work within the Claims value stream for Special Investigations. Supports liability evaluation by documenting decisions and notifying file owners, manages claims workflow routing by monitoring exceptions and rebalancing misrouted claims, and handles denial management including system logging and appeal follow-ups. Tracks retained asset account compliance and reports it to regulators on schedule.

name: SIU Investigator
description: Performs special investigations within the Claims value stream. Documents liability evaluation decisions, logs denials in the claims platform with appeal follow-ups, and supports ongoing claim management and workflow routing by monitoring exceptions and rebalancing misrouted claims. Tracks retained asset account compliance, reports it to regulators on schedule, and posts recovery receipts to the claims ledger.

name: SIU Manager
description: Leads the Special Investigations function within the Claims value stream. Oversees claims workflow routing, liability evaluation, and denial management, ensuring decisions are documented and misrouted claims rebalanced. Manages structured settlement placement and retained asset account compliance, reporting RSA status to regulators on schedule and closing recovery and demand files in the claims ledger.

name: SOC Analyst
description: Performs security event monitoring, alert triage, and threat investigation within the Cybersecurity & IAM value stream. Prioritizes confirmed alerts by severity, pivots on indicators to scope compromise, and escalates confirmed events to incident response with ownership handoff. Supports detection engineering and SOAR by testing playbooks in sandbox, promoting rules via change control, and publishing threat intelligence advisories.

name: SOC Lead
description: Leads identity and access assurance operations within the Cybersecurity & IAM value stream. Administers access certification campaigns by distributing reviewer line items, tracking completion, and escalating overdue reviews, and oversees privileged account onboarding, MFA administration, and service account rotation alerts. Monitors directory replication health, tests quarterly directory restoration, and onboards applications to the SSO platform.

name: SOX Program Manager
description: Oversees financial control activities centered on the Finance & Investments value stream, spanning Actuarial and Claims processes. Manages financial examination support and statement preparation, calculates actuarial liability balances and statutory reserve schedules, and reconciles claims and ALAE data for completeness. Supports capital instruments management, share repurchase programs, and acquisition financial support with controlled cost reconciliation and archival.
